technical.summary: Early momentum signals (MACD/Stoch crossovers) present but undermined by price trading below all major moving averages, weak RSI confirmation, and bearish cloud positioning—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: TER shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 22 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (small trades by junior member) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 22 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/Stoch crossovers with Supertrend bullish signal and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 73.32.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below all major moving averages (EMA/SMA 21/50), weak RSI confirmation (36), Ichimoku bearish cloud, VIX crisis levels, inverted yield curve, and high earnings risk in 22 days create overwhelming confluence of bearish conditions that invalidate early momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Early MACD/Stoch crossovers and extreme fear sentiment (17/100) present contrarian setup, but price remains trapped below all major moving averages with weak RSI confirmation (36), negating momentum signal reliability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (322.4), inverted yield curve signaling recession, and earnings event in 22 days create compounding volatility risk that invalidates early momentum signals and increases drawdown probability.
